summary: Task 10.1 independently verified as correct and complete. The bounded LogVerbosity enum (Off/Error/Warning/Information/Debug/Trace, default Warning) is added to PluginConfiguration, validated at configuration load with a secret-free message, carried on the immutable PluginConfigurationSnapshot, and exposed through both the ADR-016 settings page (bounded emby-select, config.LogVerbosity round-trip) and the XML configuration (legacy XML without the element keeps Warning). The plugin-owned ILogVerbosityGate reads the current snapshot on every call and maps all six levels (Off -> LogLevel.None -> nothing enabled), so a saved change applies without restart and an undefined value defensively falls back to Warning. ArrTagsServiceRegistrator registers only the gate and registers no ILoggerProvider/sink and does not replace the host ILoggerFactory. Verbosity is provably excluded from the renderer configuration fingerprint (RendererConfigurationFingerprint.Compute covers only definitions + output policy) and therefore from the render output/request fingerprints, and RenderVersion is a code-owned const, so changing verbosity cannot republish artwork (ArtworkRegenerationPlanner.Decide compares the unchanged fingerprint and skips). No production log call site was added and docs/limitations.md SEC-5 was deliberately left unchanged (task 10.3). The JSON page round-trip was independently confirmed against the pinned Jellyfin source: JsonDefaults.Options and the API MVC JSON options include JsonStringEnumConverter with PascalCase naming, so the enum serializes/deserializes as a member-name string.
